verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents an official Editor MCP Server that connects AI assistants to an open Editor session. Through it, an agent can modify project data and verify results in the viewport or a running app. The user manual names it as the way to change scenes from an agent, and a runtime probe confirms it is published on npm as @playcanvas/editor-mcp-server (v0.7.1) from the official playcanvas org. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of agents actually connecting through it, and the server is still pre-1.0 and requires a live browser Editor session.
